# Paradox.ai

## About


Paradox is a conversational AI platform that automates recruiting, hiring, and onboarding tasks. Its flagship AI assistant, Olivia, engages with candidates 24/7 to answer questions, screen for qualifications, schedule interviews, and deliver a seamless candidate experience. By handling administrative work, Paradox frees up HR teams, giving recruiters and talent leaders more time to focus on strategic initiatives and spend less time with software and more time with people. The platform integrates with major HR systems like Workday, SAP, and Oracle, supporting the entire talent lifecycle — from career site engagement to new hire onboarding.

## Products & Services

### Core Platform
- Conversational ATS is a next‑generation applicant tracking system that automates repetitive steps like screening, scheduling, and feedback collection.
- Conversational Career Sites delivers mobile-first, AI-powered experiences that help candidates discover and apply to jobs quickly, with personalized guidance from a built-in assistant.
- Conversational Scheduling automates interview coordination by using AI to instantly find and confirm mutually available times across multiple participants and time zones, eliminating manual scheduling tasks.
- Conversational Apply transforms any job application into a simple, mobile-first conversation, allowing candidates to apply in minutes via text, web, or WhatsApp. This approach dramatically increases applicant conversion by eliminating lengthy forms and logins, making it easy to apply from any device.
- Conversational CRM enables recruiters to nurture and engage passive candidates through automated SMS and email campaigns, rediscover past applicants, and build talent pipelines.
- Paradox’s Conversational Events platform automates recruiting event management by engaging candidates in real time, enabling seamless registration, reminders, and follow-up communications through AI-powered conversations.

- Deloitte Technology Fast 500: Named to the list of fastest-growing North American technology companies in 2022 and 2023.
- Brandon Hall Group Excellence Awards: Received a Gold Award for "Best Advance in AI for Business Impact."
- HR Executive Magazine: Recognized with a "Top HR Product" award.
- Forbes: Named to the list of America's Best Startup Employers.

Fairness and compliance

AI your legal team can get behind.

A purposeful, thoughtful approach to ethical AI.

We are committed to ensuring that technology is used in a way that not only drives efficiency, but also promotes fairness and enhances the hiring experience.

We pledge to only use AI that has been thoroughly vetted and in manners that comply with the following principles: Transparent, explainable, fair, accountable, secure, and safe.

Learn more

Accessibility

Experiences that are accessible for all.

All candidates deserve a fair hiring process.

Paradox is on a mission to deliver accessible candidate experiences to all job seekers.

In support of this goal, Paradox aims to ensure that its websites, applications, and content are accessible to individuals of all abilities and substantially conform to relevant, industry standard, accessibility guidelines.

Analytics

Optimize everything with instant insights.

Inform your hiring strategies with data.

Pull reports using conditional formatting and filters to tailor analysis according to specific attributes, ensuring the most relevant and valuable information.

Visualize data easily.

We track over 1,000+ metrics so that you can visualize your data with dynamic dashboards or safely and securely send metrics via sFTP to your BI tools.

Global

Transform hiring, everywhere you work.

Localization made simple.

From data privacy and scalability to security and compliance, we provide the tools necessary to comply with local regulations, no matter where you hire.

Events

Hiring events at scale, without the effort.

Make hiring events your #1 lead source.

Automate the event registration process, reminders, screening, Q&A, and instant scheduling to turn candidates into hires at every type of recruiting event.

Build your early career pipeline with qualified students through automated screening. Keep in touch with promising talent through personalized, relevant campaigns via text and email.

Security

Reliability and scale you can count on.

Validated and certified by the experts.

We worry about data security and privacy so that you don’t have to.

Paradox is proud to be leading our industry with internationally recognized security standards that safeguard your organization and candidates' data and personal information.

Integrations

Make integrations simple with open API.

Integrate seamlessly with your tech stack.

Integrations should be simple. Through direct integrations and our open API, Olivia works with the leading systems and devices you already use.

SEO

Make your jobs the easiest to find.

Optimize your career site.

When building your career site, we follow the best practices and guidelines for website development. From performance to accessibility, Paradox pages are easily crawled by search engines and built for easy mobile-first discovery.
